Chapter 604: Chapter 33: Cultivation Achievements (Please Subscribe)

The Vast Martial Realm, since the ascension of the first Martial Spirit a hundred years ago, had gradually buzzed from its once silent and dead state.

It was Lin Yuan who had opened up the Martial Realm, which was far larger in scale than both the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness. Even Martial Spirits had not explored it to its endpoint.

Over the centuries, with each ascending Martial Spirit, three areas gradually emerged in the Martial Realm.

One area was the convergence point of Martial Spirits from the Longshan Family, primarily centered around Longshan City.

Another area was the convergence point for Martial Spirits outside of the Longshan Family, primarily centered around Myriad Phenomena City.

As for the third area… that was where the great Longshan Patriarch cultivated, occupying the most central part of the Martial Realm, the land where Origin Source was most abundant.

...

The spread of the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill and the opening of the Martial Realm both originated from the Longshan Patriarch. Any Martial Spirit who ascended from the mortal world held immense respect for the Longshan Patriarch.

This was the peerless powerhouse who ended the era of gods and ushered in the Martial Tao Epoch.

Nowadays, although the Ocean of Light and Abyss of Darkness still existed, and new deities were continuously being born, their power was incomparable to that of the Martial Realm.

…

[Name: Longshan Yuan (Lin Yuan)]

[Identity: Holder of the Myriad Realms Gate]

[Bound Talent: Heaven-Defying Comprehension]

[Divine Skills: Blood Resurrection]

[Divine Skills: Mountain Moving]

[Divine Skills: Strengthening]

[Divine Skills: Elemental Body]

[Current Status: Consciousness Descent]

[Remaining Residency Duration: Three Years]

…..

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes and glanced at the rows of illusory text below him.

“The time of residency is almost at its limit.”

Lin Yuan looked forward, everything that was happening in the vast Martial Realm, he saw in its entirety.

As the opener of this world, there was nothing in the Martial Realm that could hide from him, and it was almost like a second Inner World.

“Originally, when I slew the gods, causing an overflow of worship in the mortal sphere, combined with several instances of popularizing Martial Tao cultivation, it merely took five hundred years to birth the first Martial Spirit.” Lin Yuan thought.

The Martial Spirit corresponded to the Eighth Stage of Martial Arts, although there were notable differences between the two.

The advantage of a Martial Spirit lay in leveraging Bloodline Power, thus the cultivation speed before the seventh rank was extremely fast. As long as the limit of bloodline was high enough, there were hardly any bottlenecks.

However, after reaching the seventh rank and igniting the Divine Fire, they should, in theory, lurk for long years, secretly gathering worship. However, with the fall of the gods, there was no need to be so secretive.

Moreover, with Lin Yuan’s presence, Martial Dao practitioners were confident. After the first Martial Spirit entered the Martial Realm, a large number of other Martial Spirits were quickly born.

In just a hundred years, the number of Martial Spirits in the Martial Realm had surpassed a thousand.

“Out of a thousand Martial Spirits, there are less than a hundred from the Longshan Family?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. He held a definite preference for the Longshan Family. His two Primordial Spirits often returned to the mortal realm to clarify doubts for the ‘martial prodigies’ of the Longshan Family.

However, unfortunately, the prodigies of the Longshan Family were not competitive compared to other talents from different places in the mortal realm.

This was quite normal after all. Even with Lin Yuan present, the Longshan Family was still just one family with limited members, naturally far fewer in number compared to the multitude of mortals.

However, even if the Longshan Family had only a few dozen Martial Spirits, they still held an absolute dominant position in the Martial Realm. The Martial Spirits outside of the Longshan Family dared not offend the Martial Spirits of the Longshan Family at all.

And all of this was naturally because of Lin Yuan, the Longshan Patriarch.

“Hundreds of years ago, a young member of the Longshan Family asked me to suppress the Martial Spirits outside the family, to oppress the martial prodigies of the mortal world at the source of worship…” Lin Yuan’s gaze was calm. Naturally, he had not agreed to this request.

Lin Yuan’s goal had always been set on better spreading Martial Tao. As for the rise and fall of the Longshan Family itself? He didn’t care much, as long as Martial Tao cultivation continued to spread in this world, it met expectations.

As for promoting the Longshan Family’s dominance at the expense of limiting the development of Martial Tao cultivation, Lin Yuan would naturally not do so.

He was even gradually letting go of handling the Longshan Family; he had not had the Primordial Spirits return to the mortal Longshan Ling for decades.

“Their lifespan must be reaching its limit…” Lin Yuan looked down, observing everything in the mortal realm.

With Lin Yuan’s help, the Longshan Fang Couple’s bodies had reached the maximum perfection allowed by this world.

That is the level of a Sixth-Rank Legendary Knight and directly possesses a thousand years of life.

However, after a thousand years, if they still haven’t ignited the Divine Fire, they still have to face death.

This death does not refer to physical decline, but the degeneration of the soul and Spirit Will.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, as long as he maintained the nourishment of his Inner World, the Longshan Fang Couple could probably live a few thousand more years.

But that’s only if the nourishment doesn’t stop. However, Lin Yuan was ultimately going to return to the Main World. Once he left, the Longshan Fang Couple would lose their nourishment, and their souls and spirits would quickly wither.

“To ignite the Divine Fire…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound. In this world, igniting the Divine Fire was crucial, marking the boundary between mortals and demigods.

To ignite the Divine Fire, one must rely on their unmatched will and spirit. External forces cannot play any part in this, similar to the ‘Heart Demon Tribulation’ from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Layer in the Main World.

Although there were over a hundred thousand Martial Tao Demigods in the past six hundred years, that was based on what population base.

On average, probably not even one Martial Tao Demigod would emerge from a trillion people.
